blocks.text:
Computing the chi1 dihedral angle for ILE A54, I'm setting up vectors between the backbone and side chain atoms (N, CA, CB, CG1) and beginning the cross product calculations needed to determine the torsion angle.

Computing the cross product n1×n2 and dotting it with the normalized b2 vector gives -3.77729, which I'll use as the sine numerator for the atan2 calculation to find the dihedral angle chi.

With cosine 2.119 and this sine value, atan2 gives approximately -60.7°, classifying this as a g- rotamer.
